recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the published Jira resolution in current core source without changing cardinality, type, mappings, or unrelated packaging behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-39045 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BR&R change request asking PackagedProductDefinition.packaging to distinguish containers from parts of containers. The approved resolution accepted a 0..1 boolean but explicitly changed the element name from the proposed componentPart to containerPart.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit edd2b72b3b881512640e6f6a9da68f7efd418337 added PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.componentPart to the PackagedProductDefinition StructureDefinition, capturing the boolean semantics but retaining the pre-modification name rather than the approved containerPart name.
additional_context: PackagedProductDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml is current build source. Jira searches for PackagedProductDefinition containerPart/componentPart found only FHIR-39045, Zulip searches found no contrary discussion, and BR&R minutes for 2022-11-15 record FHIR-39045 as approved with modification and notes in Jira.
reconciliation: Changed the authoritative StructureDefinition element id and path to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containerPart and aligned the short, definition, and meaningWhenMissing prose with the approved container-vs-container-part terminology.
source_changes: source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml: renamed PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.componentPart to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containerPart and updated nearby element text to match the approved name.
